#
# The required status checks on the `main` ruleset, and how each one is run.
#
# Left of `=` is the status-check context, exactly as the ruleset names it.
# Right of `=` is the recipe the job runs. The workflow contains no copy of the
# command, so local and CI cannot diverge.
#
# Adding a required check means adding it in three places - the ruleset, a
# workflow job, and here.

build           = just build
tests           = just tests
lint            = just lint
fmt             = just fmt
licence-headers = just licence-headers
cargo-deny      = just cargo-deny
msrv            = github-only: pinned toolchain, no local recipe (the host may not have 1.90 for its triple)
mutants         = just mutants   -- NOT YET IN THE RULESET; see below

# `mutants` runs on every pull request and is not yet a required status check,
# because making it one is a change to the `main` ruleset and only a repository
# admin can make it. Until then it reports and does not block, which is the
# weaker half of what it is for -- ADR-style gate-gaming resistance needs the
# check to be one a contribution cannot land without.
#
# Add `mutants` to the required checks on `main` to close that.
